meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 把代码库按功能划分成 Mermaid 流程图，标注每个节点的 file:line，找出跨功能的重复关注点，提出统一架构方案，并把每个统一系统的 /make-plan 提示词写成可直接复制的内容。它不写实现代码。
howto.when: 当你要「找到理想路径」、统一重复系统，或重构前审计架构时触发。产物放在仓库根目录的 PATHFINDER-<日期>/ 目录下。

say.text: 帮我找出这个代码库的理想路径，画出功能分组的流程图
say.note: 先做功能发现，边界要你确认后才继续

say.text: 审计一下架构，把重复的系统统一成一套
say.note: 产出重复报告和统一方案

say.text: 给统一后的每个系统生成 /make-plan 提示词

howto.what_en: Maps your repo into feature-grouped Mermaid flowcharts labeled with file:line, reports duplicated concerns with evidence, proposes a unified architecture, and writes copy-paste /make-plan prompts per system. It writes no implementation code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to find the ideal path, unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Artifacts land in PATHFINDER-<YYYY-MM-DD>/ at repo root.

say_en.text: Find the ideal path and draw feature-grouped flowcharts
say_en.note: Feature discovery runs first; boundaries need your OK

say_en.text: Audit the architecture and unify the duplicated systems
say_en.note: Produces the duplication report and unified proposal

say_en.text: Write /make-plan prompts for each unified system
